hint: The two-word phrase that anyone can say, man or woman.

example.target: Hola, me llamo Ana. Mucho gusto.
example.en: Hi, my name is Ana. Nice to meet you.

regional.text: Spain more often says encantado, or encantada if you are a woman.

trick: Gusto means pleasure, like doing something with gusto, so mucho gusto is literally much pleasure.
